segments.text: Good day, Mr. Ionescu. Did you manage to look at the apartment in Drumul Taberei?
Yes, we liked it, but the price of ninety-five thousand euros seems high to us.
May I speak with the owner for a reduction. I'll call him tomorrow.
That would be good. And we would like to see also the three-room apartment in Militari.
I'll schedule a viewing Saturday at eleven o'clock.
Perfect. What documents do we need for the loan?
I'll send you by email the list of documents by tonight.
I'll talk with the bank next week for pre-approval.
Fine. If the owner accepts eighty-eight thousand euros, we'll make the preliminary contract.
